customDescriptions.value: Estimate states of a nonlinear system using the Extended Kalman Filter — use for real-time state estimation when system dynamics are mildly nonlinear
Simulate a Hammerstein-Wiener nonlinear model — use for modeling systems with input and output static nonlinearities surrounding a linear dynamic core
Simulate any identified linear model in Simulink — use for embedding estimated transfer functions, state-space, or polynomial models into a system simulation
Estimate states of a linear system using a standard Kalman Filter — use for optimal state estimation in linear systems with Gaussian noise
Convert between identified model representations — use for transforming idpoly, idss, or idtf models into different formats for simulation
Simulate a neural network-based state space model — use for deploying deep learning-identified dynamics models in Simulink for prediction or control
Simulate a nonlinear autoregressive model with exogenous inputs — use for deploying identified NLARX models that capture nonlinear input-output behavior
Simulate a nonlinear grey-box model with estimated parameters — use for deploying first-principles models whose parameters were identified from data
Estimate states using sequential Monte Carlo sampling — use for state estimation in highly nonlinear or non-Gaussian systems where Kalman filters fail
Estimate parameters online using recursive least squares — use for adaptive identification of linear-in-parameters models during simulation
Estimate polynomial model parameters online — use for adaptive identification of ARX, ARMAX, or Output-Error models in real time
Estimate states using the Unscented Kalman Filter — use for nonlinear state estimation with better accuracy than EKF for strongly nonlinear systems
